XMLDB.COMMENT: Sentientia core — ADR-021 Wave-4 tenant registry + ADR-020 Wave-3.2 org model + ADR-032 imported admin log

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_customer
TABLE.COMMENT: Top-level Sentientia customer. Airpay = customer-zero (id 1). One customer owns >=1 tenant root.

FIELD.NAME: id
FIELD.COMMENT: Primary key

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Display name, e.g. 'Airpay Payment Services'

FIELD.NAME: shortname
FIELD.COMMENT: Machine-friendly unique handle, e.g. 'airpay'

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_tenant
TABLE.COMMENT: Tenant registry — replaces the hardcoded VALID_TENANTS=[1,77,177]. rootid is today's BizLMS cost-center root.

FIELD.NAME: id
FIELD.COMMENT: Primary key

FIELD.NAME: rootid
FIELD.COMMENT: Tenant root id (today: BizLMS cost-center root, e.g. 1/77/177)

FIELD.NAME: customerid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to local_sentientia_customer.id — the owning customer

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Display name, e.g. 'Airpay', 'Public', 'ZEEA'

FIELD.NAME: idnumber
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional external key (e.g. HRMS) — join key for sync round-trip

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: active|suspended|archived — only active roots are in the allow-list

INDEX.NAME: uq_rootid
INDEX.COMMENT: One registry row per tenant root

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_org_unit
TABLE.COMMENT: Sentientia org-hierarchy node (ADR-020 Wave 3.2). Replaces direct BizLMS cost-center reads. Dormant until 3.2b dual-write / 3.3 backfill seed it.

FIELD.NAME: id
FIELD.COMMENT: Primary key

FIELD.NAME: parentid
FIELD.COMMENT: Parent unit id; 0 = tenant root

FIELD.NAME: tenantrootid
FIELD.COMMENT: Tenant scope — the local_sentientia_tenant.rootid this unit belongs to

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Unit display name, e.g. 'Engineering', 'Risk & Compliance'

FIELD.NAME: idnumber
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional external key (HRMS dept code) — sync round-trip join key

FIELD.NAME: path
FIELD.COMMENT: Materialised ancestor path, e.g. '/1/5/12' — fast subtree queries

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_org_member
TABLE.COMMENT: User-to-org-unit membership with role (ADR-020 Wave 3.2). One row per (userid, unitid).

FIELD.NAME: id
FIELD.COMMENT: Primary key

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to mdl_user.id

FIELD.NAME: unitid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to local_sentientia_org_unit.id

FIELD.NAME: role
FIELD.COMMENT: member|manager — reserved for a future 'unit lead' concept; NOT the reporting line

FIELD.NAME: managerid
FIELD.COMMENT: Direct line-manager user id (mirrors BizLMS open_supervisorid); 0 = none. The reporting-line edge — ADR-020 2026-06-01 decision.

INDEX.NAME: uq_user_unit
INDEX.COMMENT: One membership row per user per unit

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_admin_log
TABLE.COMMENT: Imported BizLMS admin log (course insert, update and delete) and bulk course upload errors. Read-only history, written only by the ADR-032 legacy_logs importer. One row per source row; the idempotence key is local_sentientia_legacymap, not a column here.

FIELD.NAME: id
FIELD.COMMENT: Primary key. A new id: nothing outside this table stores the legacy id.

FIELD.NAME: source
FIELD.COMMENT: Legacy table the row came from: local_logs or local_courseerrors

FIELD.NAME: event
FIELD.COMMENT: local_logs.event (insert, update or delete), or upload_error for a bulk upload error

FIELD.NAME: module
FIELD.COMMENT: local_logs.module (course in every known writer), or course for an upload error

FIELD.NAME: description
FIELD.COMMENT: Verbatim. A local_logs description names the actor by first name, so it is personal data: declared in the privacy provider and scrubbed on an erasure request, the row is kept.

FIELD.NAME: itemref
FIELD.COMMENT: local_logs.type: the course id the entry is about, when BizLMS recorded one

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The actor (local_logs.usercreated, or local_courseerrors.userid); 0 = none or erased

FIELD.NAME: usermodified
FIELD.COMMENT: local_logs.usermodified; 0 = none or erased

FIELD.NAME: actor_path
FIELD.COMMENT: Tenant path: the actor's user.open_path at import time, normalised. NULL = no tenant could be resolved, visible to cross-tenant callers only.

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: Source timecreated (local_courseerrors.time)

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Source timemodified; timecreated when the source has none
